subject: InnovaHealth: private-hosting qualification & next-step alignment
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@innovahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: InnovaHealth: private-hosting qualification & next-step alignment

Hi Maya — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Summarizing our conversation and proposed next steps so we have alignment. Please call out anything I missed.

Top-level goals you shared
- Deploy Redwood Inference in a private VPC with strict egress controls for PHI-handling inference calls.
- Maintain in-region data residency (US-East) and an air-gapped option for a narrow set of workloads.
- Keep latency under ~120ms P95 for synchronous inference (customer-facing search).

Primary constraints
- Network: no outbound internet from the VPC by default; only approved egress to our managed endpoints via private peering or customer-managed NAT for specific IP ranges.
- Compliance: leadership requires SOC2 + encryption-in-flight and at-rest via your KMS (we discussed AWS KMS).
- Procurement: standard SOW + SLA review; initial POC must be completed before procurement signs off.

Questions / open items we agreed to action
1) You to share the network diagram and a prioritized list of subnets/services that must never traverse public internet (we referenced the diagram you mentioned).
2) Redwood to provide: concise POC scope (what we will run, success criteria), a proposed SOW draft, and a short list of required technical artifacts (SOC2 report, encryption configuration, access control doc).
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive (network + security) with your infra and our solutions engineering — target next week if possible.

POC high-level suggestion (we'll refine after the deep-dive)
- 2-week dedicated pool in your VPC (private connect), run a constrained model for search reranking and chat, validate latency/cost with your traffic profile, and prove KV-cache warmup approach.

Attachments: innova-network-diagram.pdf (network diagram you referenced)

Next steps I will take this afternoon:
- Draft a 1-page POC outline and SOW stub and drop into the shared Drive link.
- Pull our SOC2 summary, KMS integration notes, and a short runbook for private peering.

Would Tuesday or Wednesday next week work for a 60–90 minute tech deep-dive?

Thanks — Mark
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@innovahealth.com>

Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: InnovaHealth: private-hosting qualification & next-step alignment

Thanks Mark — this is a good summary. A few clarifications and additions from our side: first pass answers below, and I've attached the security checklist that governance wants us to use for any vendor POC.

Clarifications
- Network: we cannot allow any autonomous egress from the application subnets; all outbound must be tightly controlled. Private peering or AWS PrivateLink are preferred.
- Residency: all inference logs must stay in our US-East accounts and be retained for 7 years per our policy.
- Air-gap: for certain PHI workloads, we will require an offline deployment model (air-gapped) where model update cadence is monthly and requires manual approval.

Procurement / SLAs
- Procurement wants a draft SOW and a clear SLA for availability (we are targeting 99.95% for the dedicated environment).
- We will require indemnity language and a two-stage acceptance window for the POC.

Security artifacts we need from Redwood
- SOC2 Type II report (or summary)
- KMS integration guide + evidence of envelope encryption support
- Audit log portability plan (how we can export logs to our logging account)

Timing: we'll be on-site next Tuesday afternoon and can allocate the infra team for a 90-minute deep-dive on Wednesday 2029-04-17.

Attaching: innova-security-requirements.xlsx (Excel, 85KB)

Maya — thanks for the clarifications and the security checklist, that's very helpful. A couple quick confirmations and what we'll deliver before the deep-dive:

Confirmations
- We can run over PrivateLink or VPC peering depending on your preference; we will provide the minimal set of IPs and ports required for private connectivity and can support strict egress through our connector.
- Residency & logs: we'll provide an option to forward audit logs to your logging account (CloudWatch/S3) and a policy for 7-year retention.
- Air-gap option: we support an on-prem / air-gapped package; model updates are manual and we can provide a monthly image release process with signing.

Deliverables (by EOD Monday)
1) POC outline + success criteria (attached) — RDW-dedicated-poc-outline.pdf
2) SOW draft (Drive link) — link below for comment
3) SOC2 summary + KMS integration notes (zip in Drive)

Scheduling
- We can do the 90-minute deep-dive on Wednesday 2029-04-17 at 09:00 ET (we'll confirm engineers and bring our solutions engineer and network lead). Please confirm and we'll send a calendar invite with pre-read.

Pre-read links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3RDW-innova-poc (SOW draft, SOC2 summary, integration notes)

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.
